name: Honored Amongst the Guard

description: Honored Amongst the Guard: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The base buzzes with news of your exploits in the Field of Strife! You have struck mighty blows against our enemy - crushing their morale! For this, you have earned a rank of honor among the Stormpike.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The king has been made aware of your battlefront heroics, adventurer. Continue in your stalwart defense of the Stormpike Guard!
